# FPSOT data models specification

> How FPSOT projects define and publish entity data models: one LinkML source per model, generated JSON Schema, SQL, OWL and SHACL files with drift checks, and the Party subject area (persons, organizations, roles, relationships, contact mechanisms, identifications, classifications).

## Specification

- [Overview](spec/en/index.adoc): scope, parts and conformance.
- [Principles](spec/en/principles.adoc): DMO-001 to DMO-006.
- [LinkML source and generated files](spec/en/linkml.adoc): DMO-010 to DMO-017.
- [Names, keys and types](spec/en/names-types.adoc): DMO-020 to DMO-024.
- [Codes, names and contact data](spec/en/codes-contact.adoc): DMO-030 to DMO-036.
- [Party subject area](spec/en/party.adoc): DMO-040 to DMO-047.
- [Audit, history and extensions](spec/en/history-extensions.adoc): DMO-050 to DMO-057.
- [Versions and deprecation](spec/en/versions.adoc): DMO-060 to DMO-064.
- [Persistence and tooling](spec/en/persistence.adoc): DMO-070 to DMO-073.
